items.plain_language_rule: در هر واحد مسکونی قابل دسترس، حداقل یک فضای بهداشتی باید هم‌زمان با بند ۳-۲-۳-۸ ضابطه ۲۴۶، ارجاع آن به ۳-۱-۱-۱۲ و حداقل ۱٫۵۰×۱٫۷۰ متر مبحث چهارم منطبق باشد.
items.applicable_conditions: building_use == RESIDENTIAL AND accessible_residential_unit == true
items.source_summary: Code 246 defines a residential complex as more than four units on one floor or more than eight units across multiple floors; 3-2-2-1 requires at least five percent accessible units and at least one in fully government-funded complexes under 20 units; 3-2-3-8 requires one sanitary space conforming to 3-1-1-12.
exceptions: Five-percent integer conversion is not stated in the inspected Code 246 text and remains HUMAN_INTERPRETATION_REQUIRED.
The under-20 minimum-one-unit branch applies only to fully government-funded residential complexes.
Local elevator triggers are never inferred from floor count.
items.pass_example: An independently classified accessible residential unit contains at least one sanitary space meeting M4 dimensions and Code 246 clause 3-1-1-12.
items.fail_example: An applicable accessible unit lacks a compliant sanitary space or route.
items.boundary_example: 4 units on one floor is not a residential complex; 5 is. Eight units across multiple floors is not; 9 is. Five-percent integer conversion remains a bounded interpretation question.
items.not_applicable_example: Project/object does not satisfy: Accessible residential unit sanitary space: applies only after Code 246 residential-complex/accessibility classification or an authoritative project requirement establishes an accessible unit.; result must be NOT_APPLICABLE, never PASS.
items.input_required_behavior: If any material applicability or evaluation input is absent, return INPUT_REQUIRED. Required inputs: building_use, units_per_floor, floor_count, total_residential_units, fully_government_funded, local_elevator_requirement, accessible_residential_unit, accessible_sanitary_space_count, sanitary_dimensions_m, accessible_route_result.
items.current_unresolved_interpretation: Code 246 five-percent integer conversion requires licensed interpretation.
